requirement: A Joomla 3 sign-in refusal (a 200 that draws the login form again) is invalid_credential, no_backend_access or mfa_required, not unreachable/no_redirect

oracle.ref: PR #1737 (fix); fix evidence: Production operator alert 25/10/2026 on a Joomla 3.10.11 import: Reason: unreachable · Where: login_post/no_redirect · HTTP 200 · /administrator/index.php · Sign-in: password. Joomla 3.10.11 LoginController::login() redirects only on success; a refusal falls through to display(), a 200.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. A login POST answered with a 200 Joomla 3.10 login form carrying 'Username and password do not match…' is invalid_credential at login_post, and the run's diagnostic carries username_is_email (true for an email-shaped username, false otherwise), never the username. The same 200 with 'You do not have access to the Administrator section…' is no_backend_access; with the two factor Secret Key sentence it is mfa_required. A German Joomla 3 refusal is read through administrator/language/de-DE/de-DE.ini. The Joomla 3 login form with no message is invalid_credential/message_unread. A 200 that is not Joomla's admin login form (plain page, a form outside Joomla's template, RSFirewall's Protected Area) stays unreachable/no_redirect.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: Joomla 3 answering a wrong password with a 200 is invalid_credential, with the email shape kept
Joomla 3 answering an account without administrator access with a 200 is no_backend_access
Joomla 3 answering a missing Secret Key with a 200 is mfa_required
a German Joomla 3 refusing on a 200 is read through its language file
a Joomla 3 login form again with no message to read is message_unread, not unreachable
a 200 on the login POST that is not Joomla's login form stays unreachable/no_redirect
a challenge on a non-403 answer of the sign-in is blocked_by_firewall, not a generic failure
